name: extrude-spline-weighted
description: A rational (weighted) cubic arch: poles (0,0) (0,30) (40,30) (40,0), weights 1 3 3 1, closed by a line along the bottom, extruded 5 mm. The middle weights pull the curve towards the top poles, so it covers 913.3014 mm^2 (more than the 720 mm^2 of the unweighted arch) and reaches 27.0000 mm high. Expected values worked out independently of Khan: the NURBS evaluated with SciPy, the area by Green's theorem and the perimeter (117.2714 mm) by adaptive integration, per knot span. 4 faces: top, bottom, the curved side, the flat side.
